arm_comment: Arm D = the ENTRY-CADENCE test of the fade path. It is a byte-for-byte copy of arm C (gamma-regime entry: dealer-gamma picks CHOP=>fade / TREND=>chase; half-OR band OFF on the fade path exactly like C; two-tier ladder exit; 1-min manage; 500-lot sizing; T6 OFF) EXCEPT for ONE key: scan.scan_step_minutes=1 (arm C scans every 5 min). So a clean live C-vs-D isolates EXACTLY the effect of evaluating the fade edge-touch every minute instead of every five. WHAT IT DOES vs DOESN'T: gamma is computed ONCE PER DAY and cached (agent._gamma_cache[day]) — 1-min scanning does NOT refresh it; the opening range is frozen at 09:45 — the fade LEVELS do NOT move. The only thing 1-min changes is how often we check whether price has touched a fixed fade edge, so with dedup_minutes=30 capping one entry per symbol+direction per 30 min, arm D catches the FIRST qualifying touch up to 4 min sooner than arm C — entering closer to the reversion extreme (cheaper option, nearer the turn). HYPOTHESIS: on a chop day that earlier fill beats arm C's. RISK: the 5-min lag is crude confirmation the touch HELD; 1-min may front-run a real breakout and buy undecayed premium — the exact failure the momentum 1-min test caught (one-minute-bars-and-scan-are-null: earlier entry LOSES p=1.000 on the momentum path). This is UNTESTED for the fade path (that test was momentum) and NOT backtestable (no gamma/OI history to reconstruct chop days), so arm D is a live A/B, not a shipped edge. UNVALIDATED by construction.
mode_comment: dry_run = log intended orders only. paper = place real orders on arm D's PAPER account. The NAS supervisor runs --mode paper; keep this dry_run so a bare local run never trades.

score._comment: IDENTICAL to arm C. Band ON for momentum (require_outside_noise_band=true), OFF for fade (require_outside_noise_band_fade=false). Kept identical so C-vs-D measures the SCAN CADENCE and nothing else — arm D is arm C with a faster clock.

entry_rules._comment: IDENTICAL to arm C. dedup_minutes=30 is what bounds arm D's benefit: a faster clock cannot enter MORE (still one entry per symbol+direction per 30 min) — it can only enter the first qualifying touch EARLIER. Kept the same so it is NOT a confound for the cadence test.

regime._comment: IDENTICAL to arm C. T6 leader-breadth veto OFF; the gamma block below is the mode selector.

gamma._comment: IDENTICAL to arm C. Once per session the agent pulls Cboe's FREE delayed 0DTE chain, re-derives dealer gamma, and sets the MODE (net gamma > 0 => chop => FADE; < 0 => trend => CHASE). Cached per day — a 1-min scan does NOT refresh it. on_unavailable=abstain (fail-safe). Kept identical so the regime selection is the SAME on C and D — only the scan cadence differs.

exits._comment: IDENTICAL to arm C's two-tier ladder. Kept identical so the exit engine is NOT a confound for the cadence test. NOTE: exits already manage every 1 min on both arms (manage_step_minutes below); arm D changes only the ENTRY scan.
exits.stop_ladder_comment: Downside stop-loss ladder (all hackathon arms, 2026-09-03): sell HALF of remaining at stop1_loss_pct(-20%), the REST at stop2_loss_pct(-40%). premium_stop_pct(-65) kept as a deeper backstop (fires only on a gap past -40%). Applies in BOTH exit engines via Executor._stop_ladder_exit.

risk._sizing_comment: IDENTICAL to arm C. 500-lot target, trimmed by the per-trade cap, the aggregate cap (95000), and the account's REAL options buying power (max_open_premium = min(95000, options_buying_power)). Arm D has its OWN paper account, so its buying power/positions are fully separate from A, B and C.

scan.cadence_comment: THE ONE DIFFERENCE FROM ARM C. scan_step_minutes=1 (arm C=5): the entry scan re-fetches yfinance bars and re-evaluates the fade edge-touch EVERY MINUTE. manage_step_minutes=1 is unchanged (exits already ran every minute on C). CAUTION: 1-min scanning is 5x the yfinance load on the shared NAS IP, straight into the corrupt-volume-bar risk the score.py guard exists for; and it must read the JUST-CLOSED 1-min bar, not the forming one (bar-start leak). Everything else in this config is identical to config.armC.json so C-vs-D measures the entry scan cadence and nothing else.
